description:
About the Scholarship

The Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships are , fully funded scholarships offered by Delft University of Technology (TU Delft) for exceptional international students. The scholarship covers full tuition fees and a contribution towards living expenses for the duration of a 2-year regular MSc programme. Two scholarships are available per faculty, totalling 16 scholarships across the university. The scholarship is highly competitive and awarded based on academic excellence.

Benefits & Coverage

  • Full tuition fees (statutory or institutional rate, depending on nationality)
  • Contribution for living expenses
  • The official scholarship covers full MSc tuition and provides a contribution towards living costs; no single fixed annual stipend is stated.
  • Duration: 2 years (second-year extension depends on maintaining an average grade of 8/10 in the first year)

Eligibility and Requirements

  • International student (non-Dutch nationality)
  • (Conditionally) admitted to a 2-year regular MSc programme at TU Delft (Joint Education Programmes are not eligible)
  • Excellent academic results in previous degree (indicatively top 10% of graduates)
  • Complete MSc application submitted before the scholarship deadline
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field

Important Dates

EventDate
Application Deadline1 December 2026, 23:59 CET
Result NotificationEnd of March 2027 (via email)
Course StartSeptember 2027

Required Documents

  • Complete MSc application (with regular admission requirements)
  • Scholarship Application Form (download from official portal)
  • 1 reference letter (if you have 2 references, combine them into 1 PDF)
  • English language certificate (IELTS/TOEFL – mandatory for scholarship consideration)

Application Process (Step-by-Step)

  1. Create an account on the TU Delft MSc portal
  2. Choose your MSc programme (2-year regular programme only)
  3. Complete the regular MSc application (transcripts, degree, CV, etc.)
  4. Upload the Scholarship Application Form
  5. Upload 1 reference letter (as a single PDF)
  6. Upload your English test score (compulsory for scholarship)
  7. Submit everything before 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET
  8. Wait for the result by the end of March 2027

Key Terms & Conditions

  • Second-year scholarship extension requires maintaining an average grade of 8/10 (80%) in the first year
  • Must complete a minimum of 48 out of 60 ECTS credits in the first year
  • No financial extension beyond 2 years
  • Must remain enrolled at TU Delft during the scholarship period

Official Application Link

  • TU Delft Scholarship Portal: https://www.tudelft.nl/en/education/study-programme-orientation/practical-matters/scholarships
  • Justus & Louise van Effen Specific Page: https://www.tudelft.nl/en/education/study-programme-orientation/practical-matters/scholarships/justus-louise-van-effen-excellence-scholarships
  • Contact: TU Delft Education Service Centre

Important Tips

  • Highly competitive – only the strongest candidates are selected
  • English test is compulsory for scholarship consideration
  • Strong reference letters (academic or professional) are essential
  • Top 10% ranking proof is not officially required, but academic excellence must be showcased
  • Joint Education Programmes are not eligible – only regular MSc programmes
  • Application must be complete by 1 December – incomplete applications are automatically rejected

Bottom Line: This scholarship is fully funded for international MSc students at TU Delft – covering tuition and living expenses. The deadline is 1 December 2026, and the application is combined with MSc admission. Download the Scholarship Application Form from the official portal and submit all documents together.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.tudelft.nl/en/education/study-programme-orientation/practical-matters/scholarships/justus-louise-van-effen-excellence-scholarships

Source: tudelft.nl - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About TU Delft

TU Delft is a public technical university in Delft, the Netherlands. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral education across engineering, architecture, design and applied sciences. Its research connects technical knowledge with practical challenges, including energy, mobility, infrastructure and sustainability, through collaboration with industry, public organisations and international academic institutions worldwide.

Official website: https://www.tudelft.nl

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
